data.body: WAVE 1 - CORRECTIONS MADE DURING THE STUDY. INPUT ASYMMETRY was the largest and changed results materially: rebar reads child and referenced tickets, while the other arms initially got the parent description alone. On the 86ac epic, 5 of rebar's 6 unique TPs were child-ticket contradictions the others could not see. 14 runs were superseded to superseded/parent-only/ and re-run with related material; CE went 21->20 findings but 0->6 P0, superpowers 6->9 findings and 3->5 blocking. DUP RATE was never a duplication rate: it netted merges against SPLITS (a judge splitting one row into 2 issues pushes distinct above emitted), so it went negative. Replaced by a signed 'net merged - split' count: rebar +49, CE -3, sp -3, mini +2. rebar's +49 is the real duplication signal. PROVENANCE: 2 CE outputs no longer matched the judged snapshot; 1 recovered by verbatim title match and frozen at runs/judged/, 1 genuinely lost (a 4th concurrent CE execution alive on disk for 6 minutes) and now carrying a caveat naming all 13 rows. A sweep of all 72 arm-cells found no third case, and harness/judged.py now snapshots arm outputs at judging time and refuses clobbering.
